/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for TCP level options (via setsockopt() and getsockopt())  */
/*********************************************************************/

#define TCP_MAXSEG     5              /* TCP maximum segment size    */

                                         sending small packets       */
#define TCP_KEEPALIVE   15            /* set the socket specific keep
